findings.title: Containers lack runtime hardening beyond non-root and digest pinning
findings.note: Third-party images are digest-pinned now; hardening flags still absent.
findings.recommendation: Add cap_drop:[ALL], no-new-privileges, read_only + tmpfs, and a seccomp profile.

findings.title: First-party images are referenced by mutable tag (`:latest`/`:dev`)
findings.note: Expected for locally-built images, but deploys are not digest-pinned to the built artifact.
findings.recommendation: Deploy by image digest emitted from build-push.

report:
Dockerfile/compose runtime review. Images run
non-root; third-party images are digest-pinned. Residual: no seccomp/cap-drop/
read-only/no-new-privileges runtime profile.
